data.name: Durward
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'duruweard', composed of 'dur' meaning 'fortress' and 'weard' meaning 'guardian'. This name was given to children born to protect their families or communities.

As a Christian name, Durward emphasizes the importance of having a strong spiritual foundation, which can withstand the tests of time and adversity.
